item.title: Manchester City found guilty on 114 of 115 Premier League financial charges, reports say
item.description: Manchester City have been found guilty on 114 of the 115 Premier League financial charges brought against them, according to multiple reports, in a landmark verdict against the eight-time English champions. The charges were filed in February 2023 after a four-year investigation, as first reported…

item.title: FBI investigating claim hackers stole data of all its agents
item.description: This story concerns an unverified but partially corroborated claim of a major data breach affecting FBI personnel records, still under active investigation by the bureau. item.title: Treasury yields surge as bond selloff deepens, stocks fall for third day
item.description: Treasury yields surged Thursday as the bond selloff deepened, extending the Dow Jones Industrial Average's losing streak to a third day. item.title: FDA approves Eli Lilly's once-weekly insulin Onswik for type 2 diabetes
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved Eli Lilly and Company’s Onswik (insulin efsitora alfa-gobe), a once-weekly basal insulin injection for adults with type 2 diabetes, the company announced Sept.24, 2026.
